name: Four-move menu battle with type matchups
oneLiner: Turn-based creature battle, one on one (or two on two): each creature has up to four moves with uses left and a type; a type chart doubles, halves or cancels damage and says so in the message box; speed decides who moves first; switching to a bench creature costs the turn.
fits: party RPG where one member fights at a time
notFor: active-time gauges (speed gives extra turns, not first move)
battles with more than two combatants per side on screen

needs: creature list per side: id, name, level, types, hp, atk, def, spd, up to 4 moves
move table: name, type, power, accuracy, uses, optional status / heal / guard / drain effect
type table: strong / weak / none lists per type
a 60 Hz tick (or delta time converted to ticks)
keys up / down / left / right / ok / back (and taps in native pixels)
optional: sprites (front and back), backdrop, foe AI chooser, items
provides: turn resolution: priority, speed order, accuracy, critical hits, type multiplier, statuses, switching, fainting, win / lose
message queue with typewriter and key / auto advance
command, move, team, item menus and target picker
battle screen drawing: platforms, creatures, info boxes, message box, move menu
hit site beforeHit / onHit with amount, type multiplier, crit, killed
events: turn, phase, message, moveUsed, miss, faint, sendOut, withdraw, end
creature anchors and UI rects in native pixels
autoplay that presses the same menu keys as a player

params.label: Matchup hint in the move panel

assets: module/four-move-battle.js (global GameDNA_FourMove, no dependencies; API in module/README.md). Draws through skins/skin-api.js + a skin when loaded, else a built-in pixel16 copy. Creature art, backdrop and platforms come from the host; the starter and demo use original procedural art (src/art.js).
